summary: Browser compatibility page that boots the original DOS program with js-dos 8.4.1 and direct static language-pack loading

save_contract.restore: replace the selected initFs STARSAVE.SSS contents before DOSBox-X starts
save_contract.write: read the running virtual file through CommandInterface.fsReadFile and write it to IndexedDB

deployment.artifact: publish-github.ps1 generates a self-contained static directory
deployment.compatibility: the Pages artifact serves the selected STAR_CHS or STAR_CHT files directly; compat.html fetches one language pack on demand and keeps DOSBox-X runtime files local
deployment.asset_cache: the selected language pack is loaded in parallel and persisted in versioned Cache Storage, with in-memory fallback during the current page session
deployment.mobile: mobile entry points use autostart and avoid the previous all-language Base64 asset bundle
deployment.verified: the local and GitHub Pages artifacts boot CHS/CHT to a 640x480 canvas

remaining_risk: There is no save export/import UI yet; browser private-mode or storage eviction can still remove local saves.
